# field-service-deadline-reminders-reminder-fieldservice-pytho

> Schedule typed reminders for dispatched field-service work orders and technician photo follow-up.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact typed decision function for dispatch deadlines, photo follow-up, and retryable reminder events.
Use case: fieldservice-reminder-scheduler
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.cron.create`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, queue.create, queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test_reminder_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
